leads.name: Fortunato (holm oak), Bosco delle Pianelle
sources: http://riservaboscopianelle.it/wp/i-sentieri/ (path 8, 1600 m along a lama: 'l'albero piu grande di tutto il bosco, Fortunato, un leccio plurisecolare risparmiato al taglio')
leads.why_lead: Named by the reserve itself as the biggest tree of the wood, on a public path, but no coordinate anywhere (not in any register row I could match with certainty; could be register 06 g450, the largest girth in the reserve, which would make it a second name for the tree beside the Capitano pin or a different one on path 8). No photo, no pin. Needs the path 8 track or a reader's GPS.

leads.name: Holm oaks and Macedonian oaks near Masseria Piovacqua, Bosco delle Pianelle (path 2)
sources: http://riservaboscopianelle.it/wp/i-sentieri/ (path 2, from Masseria Piovacqua: 'lecci e fragni secolari')
leads.why_lead: Ensemble, no individual tree named, no coordinate; not a collectible point.

leads.name: Macedonian oak, R.N. Murge Orientali Sez. Signorella
leads.why_lead: Register only, approximate coordinate. Searches found no source on a public trail to it or on who owns the ground in the Signorella section; no photo or exact pin. Access unsettled.

leads.name: Macedonian oak, R.N. Murge Orientali Sez. Gorgofreddo
leads.why_lead: Same as Signorella: register coordinate only, no access or trail evidence, no photo.

leads.name: Holm oak, R.N. Murge Orientali, Masseria Angela-Trasconi
leads.why_lead: Inside a masseria; no source on visiting. Register coordinate only.

leads.name: Holm oak, Bosco delle Pianelle 07
leads.why_lead: Public reserve, but see Capitano note: possibly the same tree as the Capitano (iNat quotes 385 cm) with a mis-placed register coordinate, or a separate tree 1.2 km west. Fold or separate once one is checked on site; no pin evidence.

leads.name: Holm oak, Jazzo Scagno - Via Monti del Duca
leads.why_lead: A jazzo (farm complex), no access source; register coordinate only, about 5.8 km from the town.

leads.name: Terebinth, Masseria Russoli, Crispiano
leads.why_lead: Masseria, no access source; Crispiano, not Martina Franca; register coordinate only. Not searched further.

leads.name: Macedonian oak, Monte Ferraro, Conversano
leads.why_lead: Not searched this pass (budget); Conversano is about 45 km from Martina Franca by road, so it belongs to its own place anyway. Register coordinate only, access unknown.

leads.name: Other Martina Franca register rows (Presidente, Curcio, Monte Tullio masserie; Taranto Masseria Rossini fragno; Massafra Masseria Cicerone)
leads.why_lead: All masserie with no access source; not individually researched this pass (time box). The Puglia regional file has no rows for most of them; they sit in the national MASAF file only.

blocked.name: Holm oak, Masseria Palesi (Strada Minco di Tata)
sources: https://luoghi.italianbotanicalheritage.com/en/?p=35392 (Italian Botanical Heritage: calls the Masseria Palesi holm oak the largest in Puglia; no access info)
blocked.why_blocked: Masseria Palesi is a private 17th-century estate used as a wedding and events venue (lalista.com, zankyou.it listings; no source says visitors may walk in; official reserve and visitor pages do not list it). Not seen from a public road in any source. Fails hard rule 10 until the estate states visiting terms. Largest holm oak in Puglia per register (g540, h26); the one entry labelled Strada Minco di Tata, but the pin is about 0.6 km from that road by coordinate only, no source says it is visible from it. Worth a second look if a roadside view is ever documented.

notes: 2026-11-02 verify pass. Zero trees verified: the only public, signposted candidate (Albero del Capitano, Bosco delle Pianelle, regional reserve, free paths) fails the covered-country rule for lack of a confirmed pin or a photograph of the trunk. Masseria Palesi (7 trees) is a private events estate. Official reserve site riservaboscopianelle.it (http, /wp/ path) fetches fine. Overpass: overpass.private.coffee answered with an empty result for natural=tree nodes within 2 km of the Capitano (works, unlike overpass-api.de; empty means no OSM tree node there). Commons geosearch within 400 m of the Capitano: no files. 2026-11-02 later: the Capitano was promoted to data/research/martina-franca-verified.json on a Commons photograph whose uploader names it (File:Albero del capitano.png, CC BY-SA 4.0, Francescodimonte).
